rendered: In this paper, BA is the abbreviation for the boronic acid ligand used to functionalize the gold nanorods: 4-mercaptophenylboronic acid[1] (written in the paper as 4-MPBA, BA[2]). BA@L-HGNRs is the probe made by attaching BA to L-type helical gold nanorods.
